name: code-laundry
description: Checks AI-generated TypeScript/JavaScript before it's saved or committed: syntax, formatting, lint, types, security (Semgrep), hardcoded secrets, hallucinated or vulnerable npm packages, and AI slop. Returns pass/fixed/reject with cleaned code.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Enables LLM repair of findings the deterministic tools can't fix. Leave empty to run only local checks; nothing is sent to Anthropic then.
